title: 第十五章 望月河畔

content_zh:
里头是各路妃子争奇斗艳，正所谓三个女人就是一台戏，无数个女人凑在一起，就是一场几百万只鸭子的灾难；外头一帮亲儿子干儿子各怀心思，你来我往明枪暗箭，近侍大臣们也都只是陪着僵了一张脸笑。
赫连沛毕竟只是不着调，不是脑壳空，深宫之中过了大半辈子，治国平天下不会，争宠内斗还是明白的。
坐了会，一开始还觉得热闹，后来也烦了，挥手叫各人自便，只推说乏了。
喜公公让人呈上暖胃的汤来，赫连沛就着他的手喝了一口，问道：“北渊呢？叫他过来陪朕坐一会。”
喜公公愣了愣，去寻了一圈，发现南宁王的座位上早就空空如也了，忙着人去问。
片刻，喜公公轻声对赫连沛说道：“回皇上，王爷刚才说在外头吹了冷风，有些头疼，便告罪先回去了。”
赫连沛眼皮轻轻掀起来些，摆摆手，喜公公见他神色恹恹的，也不打扰，退立在一边。
片刻，却听见赫连沛轻轻地叹了口气，灯光下帝王的脸色显得有些黯淡，一道一道的皱纹争先恐后地从眼角流露出来，华服下，分外颓败：“连个陪朕说话的人都没有……”
这一宿，整个京城都是欢声笑语的人。
景七知道逃跑这件事，不能让赫连翊看见，这位太子殿下乃是典型的死也要拉个垫背的那种，没有说贫道死了道友还蹦跶的道理，自己难受绝见不得别人临阵脱逃。
直到赫连翊被今年新科的状元郎陆深拉着说话的时候，景七才逮着机会，脚底抹油，奔着宫外的自由世界，跑了。
他装柔弱装了一路，也没骑马，叫平安备车，窝在里面到了王府，便说要早睡。
平安倒是提心吊胆，生怕这位爷真有个头疼脑热的，见他不愿意说话，也就服侍他洗漱睡下，早早的便熄了灯。
景七听见外面没动静了，这才爬起来，换了身不打眼的麻布衣服，草草挽起头发，转到后院，年三十儿晚上，王府里的下人们也不限活动，后院静悄悄的没人看着，景七偷偷地从角门遛了出来，跑到乌溪那里。
阿伈莱一见是他，先愣了一下，才要说话，被景七一把捂住嘴。
景七闪身进了巫童府，这才放开他，笑道：“我遛出来的找你家主子的，没叫平安知道，等天亮之前再偷偷回去就得了，别声张。”
阿伈莱傻乎乎地看看他，有些不明白为什么他一个王爷出门，还要平安同意，于是点点头：“那……那我去叫巫童来。”
“不用了，他知道了，你们家那只小貂太不给面子，别人还算了，我一来就往里跑。”景七方才余光瞥见小紫貂的身影一闪而过，有些怨念，心说也没干什么，就喜欢喜欢它，得，这回成了猫嫌狗不待见的名儿算坐实了。
果然，话音儿没落，乌溪便从屋里走了出来。
景七一见，竟先愣了一下，乌溪没穿他那身黑不溜秋不露一点皮肤的衣服，只着了便装，头发松松地披在身后，没戴面纱。

他常年不见光，皮肤有些苍白，连嘴唇的颜色都淡淡地，五官比中原人深刻些，却不突兀，反而有种特别幽邃的美感。景七回过神来，指着他笑道：“怎么今天倒不再‘犹抱琵琶半遮面’，叫我这个俗人一窥仙姿了？”
乌溪“哦”了一声，十分简洁地说道：“今天没穿那身。”
景七郁卒，心说你把我当瞎子么？
其实黑纱蒙面，在南疆是赶上祭祀之类的大典的时候，巫童才会穿的衣服，平时也是不穿的，只是到了大庆以后，不自觉地和周围的人泾渭分明，出门无论见了谁，总是绷得紧紧的，那身衣服便没脱下来过。
好像带着面纱，不让别人看见他，便也不用看见别人似的。
却是因为最近景七常来闹，虽然乌溪和他养的那些大小毒物们见了这南宁王第一反应都是头大，可是心里也放松了不少，这日子渐渐有了些真实感，巫童府的大门也不再闭得那么紧。
乌溪奇怪地看了看他打扮，景七虽然平时也不是大红大绿的穿，但毕竟是养尊处优过惯了的，纵然是素衣出行，用料绣工也必然极讲究，还没见过这种寻常百姓穿的布衣在他身上。便问道：“你怎么来了……还穿成这样？”

content_en:
Inside, there are concubines from all walks of life vying for beauty. As the saying goes, three women are a drama, and countless women together are a disaster for millions of ducks. Outside, a group of biological sons and godsons have their own agendas.
After all, He Lianpei is just out of tune, not empty-headed. He has spent most of his life in the deep palace, and he is not good at running a country and bringing peace to the world. He still understands fighting for favors and fighting within.
After sitting for a while, I felt it was lively at first, but then I got tired of it. I waved my hands and told everyone to go their own way, saying that I was tired.
Eunuch Xi asked someone to bring him stomach-warming soup. Helianpei took a sip from his hand and asked, "Where is Beiyuan? Ask him to come and sit with me for a while."
Eunuch Xi was stunned for a moment, and after searching around, he found that King Nanning's seat was already empty, and he was busy asking people.
After a moment, Eunuch Xi whispered to Helianpei: "Back to the emperor, the prince just said that there was a cold wind blowing outside and he had a headache, so he apologized and went back first."
He Lianpei raised his eyelids slightly and waved his hand. Seeing that he looked gloomy, Eunuch Xi did not bother him and stood aside.
After a moment, I heard He Lianpei sigh softly. The emperor's face looked a little gloomy under the light, and wrinkles appeared one after another from the corners of his eyes. Under his fine clothes, he looked extremely depressed: "There is no one to talk to me..."
This night, the entire capital was filled with people laughing and laughing.
Jing Qi knew that he should not let He Lianyi see his escape. His Royal Highness was a typical person who wanted to support him even if he died. He did not mention the reason why a fellow Taoist still jumped after his death. He felt uncomfortable and could not see others escaping from the battle.
It wasn't until He Lianyi was pulled into conversation by Lu Shen, the top scholar in this year's new department, that Jing Qi seized the opportunity, greased the soles of his feet, and ran away to the free world outside the palace.
He pretended to be weak all the way and didn't ride a horse. He asked Ping An to prepare the car. When he arrived at the palace, he said he wanted to go to bed early.
Ping An was worried, fearing that this man really had a headache. Seeing that he was unwilling to talk, he helped him wash up and go to bed, and turned out the lights early.
When Jing Qi heard that there was no movement outside, he got up, changed into plain linen clothes, rolled up his hair hastily, and walked to the backyard. On the night of New Year's Eve, the servants in the palace were not restricted from activities. The backyard was quiet and no one was watching. Jing Qi secretly walked out from the corner door and ran to Wuxi.
When Aminlai saw it was him, he was stunned for a moment before he wanted to speak, but Jing Qi covered his mouth.
Jing Qi dodged into the Wutong Mansion, then let him go and said with a smile: "I walked out to see your master. I didn't let Ping An know about it. I just went back secretly before dawn. Don't make any announcement."
Aminlai looked at him stupidly, a little confused as to why he, a prince, wanted to go out safely and agreed, so he nodded: "Then... then I'll call the witch boy."
"No, he knows. Your little sable is too disrespectful. Others don't care. I'll run in as soon as I come." Jing Qi just caught a glimpse of the little sable passing by. He felt a little resentful and said in his heart that he didn't do anything. He just liked it. Well, this time he became known as a cat that dislikes dogs and doesn't want to be seen.
Sure enough, as soon as he finished speaking, Wu Xi walked out of the room.
When Jing Qi saw him, he was stunned for a moment. Wu Xi was not wearing his dark clothes that didn't reveal any skin. He was only wearing casual clothes, with his hair hanging loosely behind his back and no veil.
He has not seen the light all year round, his skin is a little pale, and even his lips are light in color. His facial features are deeper than those of people from the Central Plains, but they are not abrupt, but have a special and profound beauty. Jing Qi came back to his senses, pointed at him and said with a smile: "Why don't you just hold your pipa half-hiding your face today and let me, a common man, have a glimpse of the beauty of the immortal?"
Wu Xi said "Oh" and said very succinctly: "I'm not wearing that outfit today."
Jing Qi was depressed, thinking, do you think I am blind?
Actually blackWearing a gauze over the face is something that witch boys would only wear during major ceremonies such as sacrifices in southern Xinjiang. They don't usually wear it, but after Daqing, they unconsciously distinguish themselves from the people around them. No matter who they meet when they go out, they are always tight and they never take off their clothes.
It is as if he is wearing a veil to prevent others from seeing him, so that he does not need to see others.
But it was because Jing Qi often came to make trouble recently. Although Wu Xi and the big and small poisonous animals he raised had a big headache when they saw King Nanning, they felt a lot more relaxed. The days gradually became more realistic, and the door of Wutong Mansion was no longer closed so tightly.
Wu Xi looked at his attire strangely. Although Jing Qi usually didn't wear bright red or green, he was used to being pampered. Even if he traveled in plain clothes, he must be very particular about the materials and embroidery work. He had never seen such ordinary people wearing cloth clothes on him. Then he asked: "Why are you here...and dressed like this?"
